model_authored_report.summary: Executed the owner-frozen close-return contrast unchanged on the fixed composed BaoStock evidence for the single in-scope ticker and window. The bars read returned a marked preview of the composed sample only; full-sample arithmetic comes exclusively from the host research_metrics and research_specification tools. The frozen rule treats a strictly below-zero prior single-day close return as the signal, assigns unchanged closes (explicit ties) to the control bucket, executes at the next close, and measures the next single-day close return as the label, with an expected lower direction and a small positive effect margin. Host alignment shows each label runs from the execution close to the following close; consecutive labels touch at endpoints rather than positively overlapping, and the host records no positive-overlap pairs while marking serial independence as not established. The host inference outcome is inconclusive: the nominal interval is not wholly on either side of the margin, which under the frozen protocol neither confirms nor disproves the expected continuation-style direction. Economically, a lower conditional next-day return after a down day would indicate short-horizon continuation; the zero threshold with ties-to-control is a deliberate, valid split, and the margin filters economically negligible differences without modeling costs. The nominal moving-block percentile interval remains exploratory and assumption-conditional; support counts are floors, not proof of coverage, power or independence. This is post-observation development exploration on a modest single-instrument window; no alpha, gate, profitability or independence claim is made, and the owner's gradual sample-expansion and rerun plan is the appropriate next step, keeping the frozen definition unchanged.
findings: The frozen definition was executed exactly as supplied — single-day lookback, strictly below-zero comparison, ties assigned to control, single-day label horizon, lower expected direction, small positive effect margin — with no parameter tuning after seeing results.
Bars reads were preview-only rows of a composed sample; the host metrics and specification tools computed the complete permitted sample, so no claim of having read every raw row is made.

Host label geometry: with this lookback and horizon, consecutive labels touch at endpoints and positive-overlap pairs are recorded as none; the host explicitly marks serial independence as not established, so nonoverlap cannot be read as observation independence.

Unlabeled tail signals at the end of the window are dropped by alignment, leaving fewer aligned cases than signal candidates; treated and control buckets ended balanced after unchanged closes were routed to control.

The host outcome is inconclusive: the nominal moving-block percentile interval spans the margin region on both sides, so the frozen protocol classifies the contrast as unclassified rather than confirming or disproving the expected direction.

Economic reading: an expected lower next-day return after a prior down day would indicate short-horizon continuation of downward moves; the opposite sign would have indicated reversal or mean reversion. The frozen direction encodes the continuation hypothesis for the negative bucket only.

The zero threshold with explicit ties-to-control is a valid design choice: unchanged closes are economically neutral days and keeping them in the control bucket preserves usable cases and avoids arbitrary exclusion.

The small positive effect margin matters because the contrast must clear it before supporting the expected direction, filtering economically negligible daily differences; the protocol states it is a contrast threshold, not a transaction-cost or profitability model.
recommended_changes: Follow the owner authority note: gradually expand the composed BaoStock sample across longer windows and more tickers, then rerun the supervisor plus two-worker trial with enough data for genuine statistical inference, preserving the recorded budget and time windows.
Keep the frozen definition byte-identical when rerunning on expanded data; any parameter change must be a new, separately recorded post-observation exploration, not a tuning of this contrast.
Prefer adjusted or corporate-action-aware closes, or explicitly document corporate actions, since unadjusted close ratios can misattribute ex-dividend or ex-rights jumps to ordinary daily returns.
Verify exchange-calendar completeness before treating returned observations as a full trading calendar; the timing limit states returned rows are not a verified exchange calendar.

In a future round, evaluate the mirror contrast for the above-zero bucket as a separate fully resolved specification to characterize continuation versus reversal symmetrically — post-observation exploration only.
Record plan and protocol hashes and worker roles for every future trial as this session does, keeping post-observation exploration auditable.
Treat block length, replicate count, seed and nominal confidence level as fixed protocol assumptions to be stress-examined only in future rounds, never adjusted after seeing an outcome.
Do not extrapolate interval width or a decision for larger samples from this round's dispersion; only an observed expanded-sample run can speak to its own interval and decision.
limitations: Preview-only bar access: the composed sample is read as a marked preview; full-sample values live in host artifacts, and I did not read every raw row.
Unadjusted historical closes: corporate actions are unadjusted and the point-in-time vintage is unverified; returned observations are not a verified exchange calendar.
Single instrument and a single fixed window; nothing here generalizes across tickers, regimes or periods.
Tail alignment drops the final unlabeled signals; usable cases are a subset of returned observations.

The nominal moving-block percentile interval is exploratory and conditional on stationarity and dependence assumptions; nominal coverage is not certified, and enough observations alone do not certify coverage or power.

Endpoint-touching labels share no bars but dependence is not ruled out; the very effect under study, serial correlation, would violate independence, so support counts are floors rather than proof of power or independence.
An inconclusive or insufficient-data host outcome never confirms or disproves the expected direction; absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence.
Post-observation exploration without preregistration or multiple-hypothesis adjustment; no strategy P&L, backtest, official evaluation, publication or gate result exists for this round.

executed_specifications.canonical_formula: r_t = close_t / close_(t-1) - 1; signal_t = 1[r_t < 0]; equality goes to control. Signal known at close_t; execution at close_(t+1); label_t = close_(t+1+1) / close_(t+1) - 1. Indices count returned observations; exchange-calendar verification is required. Effect = -1 * (mean(label | signal) - mean(label | control)); effect margin = 0.001; minimum per bucket = 20; minimum blocks = 8. Joint non-wrapping moving-block percentile interval, coverage 0.95, block length 5, replicates 2000, seed 20261112. Insufficient support: insufficient_data. Interval wholly above/below margin: interval_above_margin/interval_below_margin; otherwise inconclusive. No confirmation, disconfirmation, profitability, independence or absence-of-effect claim.
limits: Development contrast, not a strategy P&L, official evaluation or publication.
Nominal interval requires suitable stationarity/dependence assumptions; coverage is not certified.
No adjustment for post-observation selection or multiple hypotheses; not confirmatory.
Effect margin is a contrast threshold, not a transaction-cost or profitability model.
Zero threshold and explicit ties-to-control are valid choices, not automatically defective.
Unadjusted historical closes; exchange calendar and point-in-time vintage unverified.
